{{Quote|Once upon a time, the Hutts did not live on Nal Hutta, or on its moon Nar Shaddaa. They lived on planet called Varl, and it was a terrible place, perfect for the Hutts. The world orbited two stars, Evona and Ardos, whom the Hutts said were gods and lovers. Evona was consumed by darkness, and Ardos, in rage, exploded, destroying all the other worlds of their system and blasting the very atmosphere from Varl itself.|[[Reen Irana]], to [[Mander Zuma]]|<ref name="Scourge">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]</ref>}}
The '''Hutt Cataclysms''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] civil war that ended around [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]]. The cause of the war is unknown but it tore through [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], leaving the Hutt [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Varl/Legends|Varl]] and other ancient Hutt colonies lifeless wastes. The Hutts established a [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Council of Elders]] to prevent clan rivalries from erupting into open warfare and instituted a new philosophy, called the [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]], which taught that fierce competition between the clans was how the weak were winnowed from the species.

It was a philosophy that rejected outright war and territorial conquest as methods used by lesser species. Instead of deploying their [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] armies to conquer the [[Human/Legends|Humans]] as before, the Hutt would rule humanity from within, in favor of enslavement of minor [[Species/Legends|species]]. The Hutt relocated to Evocar, which they renamed [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], where the Council of Elders was established to represent the Hutt clans. Its decisions bound any Hutt that claimed clan rights, thereby preventing any inter-Hutt rivalries from becoming too destructive.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref><ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
